gap: No result ChatGPT got states that BLUETTI's AC70 manual adds a fixed ~15 W inverter self-consumption to every small load (runtime = 768 Wh × 90% DoD × 85% ÷ (TV W + 15 W)), or that the AC70's ECO Mode, on by default, turns the AC outlet off when the load stays under 40 W, a range that includes many 32-inch TVs.
standout_why: I compared against the cited BLUETTI AC70 product page (bluettipower.com/products/ac70 and its ?variant= copy), the EcoFlow RIVER 2 Max FAQ (result 1) and powerstationsize.com/stations (result 6). The AC70 page gives only an end figure ('TV (65W): 8.2 hours') and nothing on self-consumption or ECO auto-off. The EcoFlow FAQ has nothing on AC timeout or idle draw. Powerstationsize has no idle draw, ECO mode or runtime formula. ChatGPT's own runtime calculator uses a flat '85% usable energy' with no fixed inverter overhead, so it overstates small-TV runtime by about 45% (50 W TV on the AC70: 13.1 h by its method vs 9.0 h by BLUETTI's formula).
decides: This confirms the picks and corrects the sizing. On a small TV (30–50 W), the fixed 15–17 W inverter draw costs a quarter to a third of the runtime, so ChatGPT's '500Wh = 8–14 hours for a 32-inch' is too high. More importantly, the plan can fail at the default settings: AC70 ECO Mode is on out of the box and cuts AC below 40 W, and the Anker C1000 Gen 2's Smart AC Output shuts the inverter off after 15 minutes below 20 W (per Gidon, The Technology Man). The shopper must switch these modes off for a small or dimmed TV. A large TV (65 W and up) is not affected by the cut-off and feels the overhead less.

findings.label: Inverter self-consumption used in maker's runtime formula
findings.source_title: Bluetti AC70 User Manual, p. 21 (ManualsLib copy of BLUETTI's manual)
findings.note: Manual: 'Operation time = Battery Capacity (Wh) x DoD x η ÷ (Load Power + Self-consumption of AC70)' for loads below 300 W. 'The self-consumption of AC70 is approximately 15W.' The official BLUETTI Shopify PDF would not extract, so this is read from the ManualsLib mirror of the same manual.

findings.label: Depth of discharge and inverter efficiency in maker's formula
findings.source_title: Bluetti AC70 User Manual, p. 21 (ManualsLib copy)
findings.note: The maker's worked example is a 40 W fridge: 768 Wh × 90% × 85% ÷ (40 W + 15 W) ≈ 10.7 h. Applied to a 50 W 32-inch TV: 587.5 Wh ÷ 65 W ≈ 9.0 h. ChatGPT's method (768 × 0.85 ÷ 50) gives 13.1 h. For a 30 W TV: 587.5 ÷ 45 ≈ 13.1 h vs 21.8 h.

findings.label: ECO Mode default and AC auto-off trigger
findings.value: Enabled by default; AC/DC output turns off when the load is low (less than 40 W or the set power) or there is no load 'for a while'
findings.source_title: Bluetti AC70 User Manual, sect. 8.2 ECO Mode, p. 17 (ManualsLib copy)
findings.note: Manual: 'When connecting a small power device, disable the ECO Mode for a successful and uninterrupted charge experience.' To toggle it, enter Setting Mode and press the DC power button.

findings.label: ECO Mode adjustable threshold and timer
findings.value: AC threshold 10–30 W; timer 1, 2, 3 or 4 hours

findings.note: 'You can set the power threshold of AC output and DC output to 10W-30W / 5W-10W, respectively, for 1, 2, 3, or 4 hours.'
